text: Group AI Accounts login projection and caller-redaction helpers under AccountLoginHostModel static methods; keep installer and typed Host API exports explicit instead of adding a bag of exported helper functions.
Keep page-global bridge construction private; exercise lifecycle through public snapshot/subscribe/connect boundaries instead of exporting test-only factories.

Group frame main-surface pure render-policy helpers under MainSurfaceRendering; keep its store-backed seat adapter as the explicit boundary factory. Parse nested paths with z.string regex plus a typed transform instead of runtime typeof predicates or casts.

Group addressable resource identity and registry construction under SidebarResourcePanelModel static methods; keep the page-global sidebarResourcePanels contract explicit rather than exporting a bag of helpers.
Group account usage dashboard pure helpers and constants under AccountUsageDashboardModel static methods; avoid an exported helper bag and call the cohesive model directly without aliases.

Group account logout subprocess execution and its safe environment builder under AccountLogoutProcess static methods; keep injected session and filesystem factories as explicit boundaries rather than a bag of exported helpers.

Metadata-only LlmAdapter fixtures should implement stream as a regular throwing AsyncIterable method; do not use an async generator without yield or add unreachable dummy yields merely to satisfy lint.

At dshx API JSON boundaries, omit absent optional object properties rather than assigning undefined. Zod optional accepts undefined, but the actual transport rejects it; add optional fields conditionally before returning the DTO.
